explanation.headline: The public record is incomplete; check the flagged links

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows sufentanil citrate injection as Current for both Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. and Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, with initial posting on 2022-05-03.
That same plant received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12 and additional OAI classifications after inspections ending 2011-06-17 and 2011-08-04.
Later inspections of the plant were classified VAI, most recently ending 2019-11-21, which was 894 days before the shortage posting.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 54 months.
Corvale East holds 64 vials at 9 per day (7.1 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 134 vials at 8.3 per day (16.1 days on hand).

The top-ranked option is to transfer 17 vials of 50 ug/mL, 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which requires pharmacy director approval plus a DEA Form 222 or CSOS order for this Schedule II product.

rejected.text: The Hospira plant (FEI 1021343) that manufactures the NDC 00409338221 used at both Corvale sites was classified OAI after an inspection ending 2010-01-19, which was 4184 days before the 2022-05-03 posting.
